cause_quote: The new preparation client ran `const root = createPluginSourceCaptureRoot(storage.stateDir, "plugin-preparation-");` on the Gateway thread before dispatching work to the preparation worker.
user_saw: The Gateway could briefly stop responding while plugin preparation waited for the filesystem to create a capture directory.
summary: The fix moved physical source and native capture directory and staging-token operations into the broker so filesystem delays would no longer block the Gateway event loop.
reasoning: The external-plugin preparation worker shipped with a synchronous source-root allocation on the Gateway thread, and the helper at that revision created directories and acquired the staging token synchronously. I checked that native-root allocation moved onto the host separately in #177067 and that the model-catalog pool already used synchronous directory creation, so the cited commit accounts for the external-plugin source path within a fix that covers several paths.
